releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Personal Calendar adds Upcoming Events filters for the next 7 or 30 days, plus Reminder ON/OFF badges on saved entries. Birthday, Anniversary and Important Day retain their separate pink, gold and purple badges. Existing entries and reminder scheduling are preserved.
